summary: NIFTY 50 at Quote: the INDEX_QUOTE packet carries OHLC, the change and the 52-week range, and no time, volume, trades or book totals.

notes: No live index packet was recorded.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; the Paytm web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.
The web sends the packet's 52-week high and low in Quote and Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for them.
The web sends the packet's 52-week high and low in Quote and Depth frames; the desktop's common carrier has no place for them.

The desktop sends the change under the canonical names (price_change, price_change_percent) beside the Paytm web names (change_absolute, change_percent), which it sends with the same values (feed::dialect); the web sends only its own names.

The web sends zero; the docs say leave it out (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, "Field availability": a field the stream does not carry is not invented as zero; lead decision 2026-11-09). Paytm's INDEX_QUOTE packet carries no trades, average price or book totals; the web sends 0 for each (message.get(..., 0)), the desktop's index frame leaves them out.
